note: The Q2 homes Z with the nozzle sensor on the toolhead board while the Z motors are on the mainboard, so homing uses Klipper's multi-board trsync. mcu.py: the trsync setup messages use the same reqclock as the endstop start (Kevin O'Connor, 2025-12-14). trdispatch.c: an unsigned comparison let an earlier expire time be sent to the board (2026-11-11). Klipper rebuilds its C helper itself after the change.
